notes.content:
Fix bug level 11

 The text of Secret File #3 was incorrect.


All these bugs are now fixed.
Sorry for that...

notes.title: Content and features update
notes.content:
Lot of improvement in this update! 

 New gameplay on levels (Temple, Base, volcano)
 Fighting crabüls are less easy,
 Fixed issues when you restart level, 
 Fixed linear rotation issues,
 Fixed the dialog bug (mouth movement and sound)
 Ability to delete all gameplay datas from the start menu > options
 ... and some minors corrections

We hope you'll enjoy !

notes.title: Regular Update

notes.title: NARGUL Playtest - 02/04/2022
notes.content:
Dates and registrations
The NARGUL - Humans Are Among Use playtest will take place on 2 and 3 April 2022.
To participate: register on the game page before March 31, 2022.
Conditions of participation
Player
To participate, players agree to answer a form before April 5 to help us finalize the game (and we thank them for that!).
Requirements
NARGUL - Humans Are Among Us being a PC-VR game, the user must be equipped with a configuration suitable for VR on Oculus (link), Vive or index.(see store page for more details)
Get the full game for free!
In return for this form, players will receive FREE the full version of the game, the day of the official release to thank them for their precious help!
